selection.reason: Original RGB, orbit/novel/arc appearance, visible bucket/arm and temporal residuals improve. Keep existing model as rollback.
selection.rejected_fixed_body: Completed but novel foreground PSNR falls to 19.114 dB and original PSNR to 32.231 dB. Footprint widening further degrades validation; do not activate.
selection.limitations: Whole-refinement source depth MAE and low-coverage/front-occlusion fractions slightly regress outside protected parts. Residual rear-angle grain remains. Supplied-source views are not captured novel-view ground truth.
selection.runtime_fix: Module-level proxies remove per-frame class cycles; 120 GPU forward/backward passes with cyclic GC disabled show zero allocated-memory growth after warmup.
